observations: Photo 0: a black three-layer console on a table, 'PS4' printed at the front right of the lid and 'STAR WARS' printed on the front edge.
The lid carries a Galactic Empire crest and a red stripe, the Star Wars edition design; it may be the factory edition or an applied skin.
The three stacked layers of the body match the PS4 Pro shape, not the slim or the original PS4.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers with the light bar strip on the touchpad (later version), an HDMI cable, a power cord and a charging cable lie on top.
The console is switched off; no screen, no storage label, no underside, no rear ports and no serial are shown.
Controllers show normal use; no cracks visible on the lid; shop watermark 'Game Arena Offical' on the photo.

identity.kind: game console with two controllers and cables
read_from: photo 0 'STAR WARS' on the front edge
photo 0 three-layer PS4 Pro body shape

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'PS4' on the lid and the three-layer body only the Pro has; storage size and serial are not shown.
Sales wording about the model, not about this unit.
Lid looks clean in photo 0 but only the top is shown and the controllers show use.
Internal history cannot be seen; the warranty seal and screws on the back are not shown.
Console is off; no clip of it booting, reading a disc or the controllers working.
No receipt or warranty card is shown.

risks.risk: Console does not boot, overheats, or the disc drive or HDMI port is faulty.
risks.proof: Clip powering on to the home screen on a TV, inserting a disc that loads, and playing for a few minutes.

risks.risk: Controllers have stick drift, dead buttons or weak batteries.
risks.proof: Clip of each controller moving the cursor and pressing every button on screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console without working controllers

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network or still locked to another account.
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings showing a successful PSN connection test.

risks.risk: Not the original Star Wars edition but a standard Pro with a skin, or a different model than the shape suggests.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside label showing the model number and serial, and Settings > System Information screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard PS4 Pro

risks.risk: Storage smaller or hard drive failing.
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > Storage showing capacity.

proof_requests: Clip powering on to the home screen and loading a disc game
Photo of the underside label with model number and serial
Screenshot of Settings > Storage and a PSN connection test
response.reason: Photo 0 reads 'PS4' and shows the three-layer Pro body with two controllers and cables, so it can be priced at its worst case as a standard PS4 Pro not proven working until a power-on clip is shown.
